what: An example wing made for the demo: a tapered, swept half wing whose skeleton, two spars with caps and nine ribs, is carbon laminate under a clear film

wing.sweep_measures: how far aft of the root's leading edge the tip's leading edge lies, along x
wing.caps_measure: the share of the local chord each spar's two caps reach fore and aft of its web, on the aerofoil's two faces
wing.cover: A clear film over the skeleton, drawn only: it has no plies and no properties in this record, it is not in the model that is solved, and it carries no load in the analysis.

load.how: Pushed up at the 16 points where the top of each of the 2 spars' webs meets one of the 8 ribs outboard of the root, in equal shares; the skeleton's root is held; the film carries nothing.

displacement.drawn: The rows after the analysed nodes are the cover's own nodes and are not the solver's: each is set on the straight line through what the solver gives the two spar webs at its span station and height (the middle of the webs for the leading and the trailing edge), so the film is drawn riding on the skeleton.
